candidates.content: Li Mingzhao与妻子Chen Zhen自1996年起用尽全部积蓄寻找儿子；儿子曾被Li的一名工友在建筑工地抢走。
candidates.quote: Li Mingzhao and his wife, Chen Zhen, have spent all their savings looking for their son since he was snatched away by a co-worker of Li's on a construction site in 1996.

candidates.content: 母亲记得Pengpeng的眉骨上有一道疤痕，并称他两岁时曾跌倒在地。
candidates.quote: 'I remember this scar he had on the brow bone. He fell on the ground when he was two,' said the mother.

candidates.content: Li先生回忆称，他把儿子Pengpeng带到水泥厂工作，一名姓Yang的同事主动照看Pengpeng。
candidates.quote: Mr Li recalled the fateful day when he lost his son, known as Pengpeng. He brought Pengpeng to a cement factory to work and a colleague, surnamed Yang, volunteered to look after Pengpeng.
However, Pengpeng did not go home that night.

candidates.content: 夫妇二人去了Mr Yang的家中，但他已经逃走。
candidates.quote: The couple went to Mr Yang's home, but he had already fled.

candidates.content: Li先生一直没有更换手机号码，几十年来夫妇二人一直住在同一间破旧砖房中，等待儿子回来。
candidates.quote: Mr Li had not changed his mobile phone number ever since and the couple stayed in the same shabby brick house over the decades hoping to wait for their son's return.

candidates.content: 2010年，警方在四川抓获了绑架者；夫妇二人得知儿子已被卖给另一名同样姓Yang的绑架者。
candidates.quote: In 2010, police caught the abductor in Sichuan. The couple has learnt that their son was sold to another abductor, who is also surnamed Yang.

candidates.content: 据警方声明，警方在八年后抓获第二名绑架者，并查明Pengpeng被卖给了一对夫妇。
candidates.quote: The police caught the second abductor eight years after and found out Pengpeng got sold to a couple, according to the police statement.

candidates.content: 警方请绘图员Lin Yuhui根据李先生儿子四岁时的照片绘制其画像；Lin Yuhui此前曾帮助一名出租车司机找到失散的女儿。
candidates.quote: Police officer also asked their sketch artist, Lin Yuhui, who previously helped a taxi driver found his long-lost daughter, to sketch Mr Li's son based on the then four-year-old boy's picture.

candidates.content: 4月，警方告知Li先生及其妻子，DNA样本检测已有匹配结果。
candidates.quote: In April, Mr Li and his wife were told by the police that they had a match in a DNA sample test.

candidates.content: 经确认，Li夫妇的儿子是一名26岁的男子，姓Liu，现居河北省武安市。
candidates.quote: It's confirmed that their son to be a 26-year-old man, surnamed Liu, living in Wuan city of Hebei Province.

candidates.content: 团聚时，Pengpeng告诉父母，他已经结婚并有两个孩子。
candidates.quote: During the reunion, Pengpeng mentioned to his parents that he is married and has two children.
